en-US.longDescription:
Longbridge Terminal is an AI-native command-line tool for the Longbridge Securities platform.
It provides real-time market data, portfolio management, and trading across HK, US, A-share, and
Singapore markets. Outputs structured JSON for AI-agent tool-calling and also ships a full-screen
TUI for interactive monitoring.

Key capabilities:
- Real-time quotes, depth, K-lines, options, and warrants
- Account balances, stock and fund positions
- Order submission, modification, cancellation, and execution history
- Designed for scripting, AI-agent integration, and daily trading workflows

en-US.releaseNotes:
## v0.31.1

• **Unknown symbols are errors, with a fix you can use.** `quote`, `static` and `calc-index` now exit non-zero when a symbol does not resolve. Symbols that do resolve are still printed on stdout. Every suggestion is checked before it is shown, so the CLI never recommends a spelling that is just as empty:
  • `DJI.US` → Did you mean ".DJI.US"?
  • `BRK-B.US` → Did you mean "BRK.B.US"?
  • `tesla.US` → no security matches; use the ticker symbol (e.g. TSLA.US), not the company name.
  • `TSLA.US` with no quote access → the symbol exists but returned no data; check `longbridge auth status`.

  If a script relied on exit 0 with an empty or partial result, check the exit status or stderr instead, and don't discard stdout on a non-zero exit (#340).
• **`depth`, `brokers`, `trades`, `intraday`, `kline` and `kline history`** add the same suggestion under the server's `invalid symbol` error.
• **Symbols are case-insensitive.** `tsla.us` works everywhere a symbol is accepted.
• **`403308` says what to grant.** When a command needs a permission your login did not include (e.g. "Account & Positions" for `portfolio`, "Watchlist" for `watchlist`), the error names it and tells you to run `longbridge auth login` and tick it on the consent screen.
• **`--format json` errors are JSON**, including "not logged in". stderr carries `{"error"：{"code", "message", "trace_id", "hints", "symbols"}}`. Each `symbols` entry has a stable `status` (`no_data`, `suggest`, `unknown`, `unchecked`), so scripts don't need to parse the message. Usage errors (unknown flag) are still clap's text, exit code 2.

**Full changelog**：https://github.com/longbridge/longbridge-terminal/compare/v0.31.0...v0.31.1
